pol-odd-04-c3.quote: The 12th Amendment, which was ratified in 1804, corrected some of the system’s problems by providing for separate Electoral College votes for President and Vice President.
pol-odd-04-c3.claim: the 12th amendment (1804) separated the votes for president and vice president

pol-odd-04-c3.text: Congressional Research Service, Library of Congress (1992). Proposed Amendments Not Ratified by the States. The Constitution of the United States of America: Analysis and Interpretation (1992 ed.), U.S. Government Printing Office.
